description: Lebanese Rishta Lentil Noodles is a heartwarming and traditional dish, combining tender lentils with homemade or store-bought pasta in a flavorful broth. This comforting Middle Eastern staple is often enjoyed during cooler months, offering a delightful blend of textures and savory aromas. It's a simple yet deeply satisfying meal that brings the taste of Lebanese home cooking to your table.

instructions.title: Cook the Lentils
instructions.text: In a large pot, combine the rinsed lentils with 4 cups of water or vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape. Do not overcook. Drain any excess liquid if necessary, but keep the lentils in the pot.

instructions.title: Prepare the Aromatic Base
instructions.text: While the lentils are cooking, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the finely chopped onion and saute for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deeply caramelized and golden brown. Remove about half of the crispy onions and set aside for garnish.

instructions.title: Infuse Flavors
instructions.text: To the skillet with the remaining onions, add the minced garlic, ground cumin, and ground coriander. Cook for another 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until fragrant. Be careful not to burn the garlic.

instructions.title: Combine and Simmer
instructions.text: Add the onion and spice mixture from the skillet to the pot with the cooked lentils. Pour in the remaining 2 cups of water or vegetable broth, the 1/4 cup of olive oil, salt, and black pepper. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil.

instructions.title: Add the Noodles
instructions.text: Once the liquid is boiling, add the flat egg noodles to the pot. Stir gently to prevent sticking. Cook for 8-10 minutes, or according to package directions, until the noodles are al dente. The dish should have a soupy consistency; add a little more hot water or broth if it becomes too thick.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Stir in the fresh chopped cilantro and freshly squeezed lemon juice. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed. Ladle the hot Rishta Lentil Noodles into bowls. Garnish generously with the reserved crispy caramelized onions and extra fresh cilantro. Serve immediately.

tips: For truly authentic flavor, try making your own simple pasta dough and cutting it into small squares or diamonds.
Adjust the amount of lemon juice to your preference; a little extra zest can brighten the dish beautifully.
Leftovers can be stored in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat gently on the stovetop, adding a splash of water or broth if needed.
